design.seeds: data seed 10000 + 1000*index(lambda in validate_instrument.LEVELS) + rep (identical replicates to validate_instrument.py); (a) bootstrap seed = rep
design.a_fixed: target-clustered paired percentile bootstrap of the test block, models fixed, 200 resamples (existing method)
design.b_refit: 200 resamples: target clusters drawn with replacement separately in train and test blocks; both learners (h=0, h=inf) refit on the resampled training rows; paired LAP on the resampled test rows; percentile 95% CI (b_refit), basic (b_refit_basic) and normal LAP +/- 1.96 sd (b_refit_normal) from the same draws
design.c_inflate: LAP +/- 1.96 sqrt(var(a draws) + var(train-resample-only LAP)), the latter from the (b) refits evaluated on the full original test block
design.coverage: coverage_of_mean_lap: CI contains the mean LAP over the same (refit) replicates (definition of validate_instrument.py); coverage_of_precise_mean_lap: CI contains the mean over all point replicates of that level
design.mcse: binomial sqrt(p(1-p)/R) for rates; sd/sqrt(R) for mean width
design.learner: HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_depth=3, learning_rate=0.06, max_iter=300, l2=1.0), seed 0; OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 per worker
